verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ طُوبَى لِكُلِّ مَنْ يَتَّقِي ٱلرَّبَّ، وَيَسْلُكُ فِي طُرُقِهِ.
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees. Blessed [is] every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ تَأْكُلُ تَعَبَ يَدَيْكَ، طُوبَاكَ وَخَيْرٌ لَكَ.
verses.kjv: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy [shalt] thou [be], and [it shall be] well with thee.
verses.web: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

verses.ar: ٱمْرَأَتُكَ مِثْلُ كَرْمَةٍ مُثْمِرَةٍ فِي جَوَانِبِ بَيْتِكَ. بَنُوكَ مِثْلُ غُرُوسِ ٱلزَّيْتُونِ حَوْلَ مَائِدَتِكَ.
verses.kjv: Thy wife [shall be] as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.web: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

verses.kjv: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
verses.web: Behold, this is how the man who fears Yahweh is blessed.

verses.ar: يُبَارِكُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنْ صِهْيَوْنَ، وَتُبْصِرُ خَيْرَ أُورُشَلِيمَ كُلَّ أَيَّامِ حَيَاتِكَ،
verses.kjv: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.web: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

verses.ar: وَتَرَى بَنِي بَنِيكَ. سَلَامٌ عَلَى إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, [and] peace upon Israel.
verses.web: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
